title: Add slash goal command tests
objective: Define /goal command behavior before implementing it.
context: Claude Code exposes status and clear-style aliases. This project should support Codex controls while accepting clear aliases where cheap.

source_evidence.note: commands.Context is the runtime dependency injection point for slash commands.
RegisterBuiltins is where /goal must be registered.

include: Test /goal show with no active goal.
Test /goal <text> creates or replaces the objective.
Test /goal edit <text>, pause, resume, clear, status.
Test clear aliases: stop, off, reset, none, cancel.
exclude: Do not implement command production code.
Do not persist session metadata directly from tests.

implementation_steps: Create a fake GoalRuntime for command tests.
Write table tests around Registry.Parse and cmd.Execute.
Assert RegisterBuiltins includes /goal once implementation exists.
acceptance_criteria: Tests define user-visible messages without overfitting exact punctuation.
Tests require commands.Context to expose a narrow GoalRuntime interface.
No TUI dependency is introduced into commands tests.
risks: Command grammar can grow too large for the MVP.
dispatch_prompt: Add failing tests for the /goal slash command and a fake GoalRuntime. Cover show, set, edit, pause, resume, clear aliases, and validation. Do not implement command code.
notes_for_assignee: Prefer command grammar that is friendly to both Codex-style controls and Claude-style clear aliases.
